 Stonebwoy announces date for 2026 BHIM Festival
 Source Adomonline.com 
 News 
 October 23, 2026 10:20 am 
 -
 Audio By Carbonatix
 Ghanaian dancehall artiste Stonebwoy has announced December 24, 2026, as the date for the next edition of his annual BHIM Festival.
 In a post on X, formerly Twitter, the musician disclosed that the festival will take place at the University of Ghana Sports Stadium at Legon.
 He also urged fans to secure their tickets through the official website, bhimfestival.com, or by dialling 7142026#.
 Early Birds Flown Out!! 
BHIM IS A NATION. 
https://t.co/7ByrqF8VVJ
— THE TORCHER (@stonebwoy) October 23, 2026 
 The BHIM Festival is one of Stonebwoy’s flagship music events, bringing together music lovers to celebrate Ghanaian music and dancehall culture.
 The 2026 edition is expected to attract fans from across the country and beyond for a night of live performances and entertainment.
